shellCommands.command: ls node_modules/.bin/ 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo "---TSC---" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20

(timeout 60 npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 12; curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE "Dashboard|Products|Sample Product|Profile|Sample User|user@example.com|not implemented" | sort -u; echo "---exit:$?---"
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; git status --short && echo "---TSCONFIG DIFF---" && git diff tsconfig.json
git status --short; echo "---TSCONFIG DIFF---"; git diff tsconfig.json
cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---"; git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf /workspace/.next /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo /workspace/next-env.d.ts; echo "---AFTER---"; git status --short
find /workspace/app -type d 2>/dev/null; echo "---route files---"; find /workspace -name "route.*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.next/*" 2>/dev/null | head
